paragraphs.text: We fine-tune RoBERTa on SST-2 and report F1 of 0.93 in our classification experiments.
Devlin et al. reported that BERT outperforms the CNN baseline on SST-2.
A graph neural network reranker is applied to the retrieval task on MS MARCO.
